component.name: ChannelItem
component.script:
sub init_x() m.logo = m.top.findNode("logo") m.name = m.top.findNode("name") m.fav = m.top.findNode("fav") m.now = m.top.findNode("now") m.off = m.top.findNode("off") end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("ChannelItem.init", e) end try end sub
sub onContent_x() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.name.text = c.title m.logo.uri = c.HDPosterUrl m.fav.visible = (c.shortDescriptionLine2 = "fav") m.off.visible = (c.shortDescriptionLine1 = "off") m.now.text = c.description if c.description <> "" m.name.translation = [136, 4] m.name.height = 40 else m.name.translation = [136, 0] m.name.height = 72 end if onFocus() end sub sub onContent() try onContent_x() catch e reportCrash("ChannelItem.onContent", e) end try end sub
sub onFocus_x() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.listHasFocus m.name.color = "0x0F1014FF" m.now.color = "0x2A2D36FF" else m.name.color = "0xE6E7EAFF" m.now.color = "0x9A9DA6FF" end if end sub sub onFocus() try onFocus_x() catch e reportCrash("ChannelItem.onFocus", e) end try end sub
